preflight.purpose: Rebuild package outputs required by clean-checkout package exports before individual suites run.

requiredSuites.selection: The clean/current/previous-schema migration case selected from the five-case restore file.

executionNotes.observation: After pnpm clean, a direct contract-suite run failed because package build outputs had not yet been rebuilt.
executionNotes.remediation: Moved pnpm typecheck before contracts:validate in the quickstart, committed the repair, and reran every claimed suite.

executionNotes.observation: The initial capacity report mislabeled scheduler duration as browser visibility and bypassed the HTTP boundary for command durability.
executionNotes.remediation: Measured PostgreSQL event commit-to-connected-Chromium visibility and all six supervisor commands over loopback HTTP, committed the repair, and reran every claimed suite against 885800169f705d1614b7464e15b0fe9b6385d160.

executionNotes.observation: Independent review found that restore accepted a no-op validation callback, the 1/3/5 measurements decoupled in-memory scheduling from synthetic browser events, and report hashes referred only to ignored test-results files.
executionNotes.remediation: Required a structured projection rebuild proof plus independent restored-database invariants, exercised browser-submitted 1/3/5 projects through configurable PostgreSQL control planes, retained canonical browser and exact capacity reports, committed the repairs, and reran the full deterministic suite against 39f7416827886fe34ae3f2aab18c4272681bc577.

executionNotes.observation: Fresh independent review found that capacity used multiple projects with specialist-limit overrides and that restore trusted a scheduler-stopped boolean without excluding concurrent control-plane writes.
executionNotes.remediation: Reworked 1/3/5 into one browser-submitted PostgreSQL project with one specialist and the default specialist limit, added a no-backend cognitive queue probe, enforced a PostgreSQL maintenance read/write lock through restore reconstruction proof, added a deterministic concurrent-submission race, and reran every claimed suite against de2f29d640351b219c2be09121784006d9d9bc7e.
